YOUR HOME FOR
5-A-SIDE FOOTBALL IN CHINGFORD
Tottenham, Walthamstow, Edmonton, Leyton/ Leytonstone, Ilford and Wanstead

Goals Chingford offers the best small-sided football facilities in the city. Simple.

From our individually floodlit arenas complete with cutting-edge, all-weather surfaces to our additional top-class facilities, competitive leagues, and exciting local tournaments, our home form is truly outstanding.

You can keep up-to-date with us on social media, here.

DIRECTIONS TO CHINGFORD

Goals Chingford is located just off the Crooked Billet roundabout on the A406 (North Circular) just past Walthamstow Dog Track next to Morrisons Supermarket. 

A PERFECT MATCH?

Our doors are open to the community offering football pitch hire for all on 5 and 7-a-side arenas, kid's parties, corporate events, functions, and hall hire.

Football is a great way to have fun and get fit and with our artificial surface, ProTurf®, you'll be playing as close to grass as you can be. It's designed specifically for small-sided football, and completely exclusive to Goals delivering natural gameplay, pace, and is easier on your joints allowing you to play for longer. Choose a casual pitch booking for game time with no commitment, playing when you like, as often as you like.

Dedicated baller? We've got you covered with a block booking. Secure the same pitch at the same time every week with 0 upfront cost, simply pay as normal every week. You'll also be eligible for loyalty vouchers that can be used to pay for those post-match pints in our players' lounge.

Play football, get fit, feel good. Take your game to the next level by tapping below.

Join our professional-run football leagues with dedicated league managers, committed teams of all abilities, Goals referees, and great winner's prizes are up for grabs!

So... How does it work? Simply get your team together and play a trial game at a reduced cost; this is where you get a taste of the Goals League experience. We then evaluate your team's ability before allocating you to an appropriate, competitive division.

PLANNING A PARTY?

A dedicated in-house events team is on hand to help with catering, decorations, and music options, leaving you free to relax and enjoy your occasion.


Our modern function suite is available on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, holding up to 120 people, including children so you won't need to compromise on your guestlist. Available for as little as a refundable £150 deposit. A late license is also available on request for a small additional charge, so you can party into midnight.


Hall hire, event hire, weddings, engagement parties, retirement parties, or milestone birthdays, whatever your event, we can look after you. 


Get in touch below and let us take care of the rest.

ENQUIRE
FOOTBALL PARTIES

Enjoy an unforgettable kids party at GOALS whatever the weather, on our outdoor all-weather ProTurf pitches. Whether you choose our Premier Party or prefer to Build Your Own, your little football star is guaranteed a day to remember.

Parties are priced based on a minimum of 10 children, with the option to add more guests for an additional cost - either when booking or closer to the big day.

Every party takes place in a fun, safe and fully supervised environment, giving you peace of mind while the kids enjoy non-stop football action.

And that’s just the start - from Panini goodies and party bags to trophies, medals, and tasty upgrades like pizza, ice cream and slushies, there are loads of ways to make their big day even more unforgettable.

FIND OUT MORE
KICKABOUT

Maybe you’re not a planner, after a casual Kickabout with a few friends or, you’re a parent trying to keep your children active; our Kickabout sessions are a flexible way to level up.

Pitches are available from the early morning to late night sessions on fully enclosed arenas from only £6 per player on 5-a-side or £8 per player on 8-a-side.

Stay fit with your friends
Play when it suits you
1 hour pitch time guaranteed
No booking required
No commitment

Get your mates together, hit the pitch, and play football.

*Pitch exclusivity isn’t guaranteed, this is subject to pitch availability.

Chingford
29/04/2026

We recently celebrated my son’s 7th birthday at Goals Chingford this April, and the experience was brilliant from start to finish. The entire team delivered exceptional customer service and helped make the day special.
I have used Goals for a previous party for my other son so knew the experience would be good.

Our party hosts Russel and Azaan were warm, energetic and brilliant with the kids. The Centre Manager Darren ensured everything ran smoothly, and the wider party team — Zoe, Adriana and Lavel — were incredibly supportive throughout.

They were very accommodating in giving us the flexibility to confirm final numbers, and they helped with both the setup and the full clear‑down afterwards, which made the day so much easier for us. The football games were coordinated superbly, keeping all the children engaged, excited and included. The atmosphere they created was fun, safe and well organised.

We also received lots of positive feedback from other parents.

A huge thank you to all mentioned above.

Chingford
25/07/2026

We just had my son’s 6th birthday party at Goals Chingford, and it was absolutely fantastic. We did the World Cup package, which was the limited edition change to the Premiership package. The team literally organised everything and did all the decorating, and they even provided a football cake (which was way better than I expected, on a Lego platform and everything!) and very cool party bags, for which we could choose a couple of add-ons. Literally all I did was bring a number balloon and number cake topper - both of course optional - and make food choices, which I ended up changing a couple of days before the party and this wasn’t an issue.

The party host Blake was phenomenal - he has a really natural manner with kids and was able to keep them constantly engaged and having fun, whilst also being able to keep them in line if they started getting a bit out of control! He really smashed our expectations. Medina, the manager, was absolutely fantastic, and ensured everything ran seamlessly so that we could relax and have fun - thank you so much!

I really wouldn’t hesitate booking another party here, and everyone said they and their kids loved it (and great idea re the parents vs kids match at the end!)
